values.note: 336 campsites on the booking maps (the DNR page says 338): West Loop 63, Central 128, East 145, wooded with lots of tree cover. Allowed equipment is 25-50 ft at 294 sites and 20 ft or unlisted at 42; four pull-throughs (West 108, 201, 202; East 250). A 10-site bike-loop overflow area, two mini cabins and a rustic group camp are separate.

note: Keith J. Charters Traverse City State Park: an urban Michigan DNR campground 2 miles from downtown Traverse City, in three wooded loops (West, Central, East). The day-use area, directly across US-31 by a pedestrian crossing, has a quarter-mile sandy beach and buoyed swim area on the East Arm of Grand Traverse Bay. The paved TART Trail runs beside the park, linking to the Leelanau Trail. --Claude
